name: humane-commit-flow
description: Creates atomic, natural Git commits, runs applicable guard skills, and pushes safely.

interface.shortDescription: Atomic commits, guard review, and safe push.
interface.longDescription: Turns finished work into the largest useful set of logical commits, validates it with relevant guard skills and project checks, then pushes when authorized.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $humane-commit-flow to split the finished work into logical commits, run applicable guard skills, and push safely.
